{"final":{"summary":"Three searches returned only two distinct past incidents, both with Redis cache stampede as the root cause and the same fix (restart Redis and pre-warm hot keys). INC-0440 (2026-02-20) matches the current symptoms of slow assistant replies and late notifications, and INC-0412 (2026-01-18) matches late balance notifications on portfolio-svc. Neither past record says whether a non-deploy change preceded it, so the hint about a non-deploy trigger is unresolved.
